verses: Jab qayamat qaeem ho jaye gi
Jiss kay waqey honey mein koi jhoot nahi
Woh pust kerney wali aur buland kerney wali hogi
Jabkay zamin zalzalay kay sath hila di jaye gi
Aur pahar bilkul reza reza ker diye jayen gay
Phir woh misil paragandah ghubaar kay ho jayen gay
Aur tum teen jamaton mein ho jao gay
Pus dahanay hath walay kaisay achay hain dahanay hath walay
Aur bayen hath walay kiya haal hai bayen hath walon ka
Aur jo aagay walay hain woh to aagay walay hi hain
Woh bilkul nazdeeki hasil kiye huye hain
Nematon wali jannaton mein hain
(boht bara) giroh to aglay logon mein say hoga
Aur thoray say pichlay logon mein say
Yeh log soney kay taaron say banay huye takhton per
Aik doosray samnay takiya lagaye bethay hun gay
Unn kay pass aisay larkay jo hamesha (larkay hi) rahen gay aamdoraft keren gay
Aabkhoray aur jug ley ker aur aisa jam ley ker jo behti hui sharab say per ho
Jiss say na sir mein dard ho na aqal mein fatoor aaye
Aur aisay meway liye huye jo unn ki pasand kay hun
Aur parindon kay gosht jo unhen marghoob hun
Aur bari bari aankhon wali hooren
Jo chupay huye motiyon ki tarah hain
Yeh sila hai unn kay aemaal ka
Na o haan bakwas sunen gay aur na gunah ki baat
Sirf salam hi salam ki awaz hogi
Aur dahanay hath walay kiya hi achay hain dahanay hath walay
Woh kanton ki bairiyon
Aur teh ba teh keelon
Aur lambay lambay sayon
Aur behtay huye paaniyon
Aur ba-kasrat phalon mein
Jo na khatam hun na rok liye jayen
Aur unchay unchay farshon mein hun gay
Hum ney unn ki (biwiyon ko) khaas tor per banaya hai
Aur hum ney unhen kanwariyan bana diya hai
Mohabbat waliyan aur hum umar hain
Dayen hath walon kay liye hain
Jamm jamm-e-ghafeer hai aglon mein say
Aur boht bari jamat hai pichlon mein say
Aur bayen hath walay kiya hain bayen hath walay
Garum hua aur garum pani mein (hun gay)
Siyah dhuyen kay saye mein
Jo na thanda hai na farhat bakhsh
Be-shak yeh log uss say pehlay boht nazon mein palay huye thay
Aur baray baray gunahon per israr kertay thay
Aur kehtay thay kay kiya jab hum marr jayen gay aur mitti aur haddi ho jayen gay to kiya hum phir doobara utha kharay kiye jayen gay
Aur kiya humaray aglay baap dada bhi?
Aap keh dijiye kay yaqeenan sab aglay aur pichlay
Zaroor jama kiye jayen gay aik muqarrar din kay waqt
Phir tum aey gumraho jhutlanay walo
Albatta khaney walay ho thoher ka darakht
Aur ussi say pet bharnay walay ho
Phir uss per garum kholta pani peenay walay ho
Phir peenay walay bhi piyasay oonton ki tarah
Qayamat kay din unn ki mehmani yeh hai
Hum hi ney tum sab ko peda kiya hai phir tum kiyon bawar nahi kertay?
Acha phir yeh to batlao kay jo mani tum tapkatay ho
Kiya uss ka (insan) tum banatay ho ya peda kerney walay hum hi hain?
Hum hi ney tum mein maut ko mutayyen ker diya hai aur hum uss say haaray huye nahi hain
Kay tumhari jagah tum jaisay aur peda ker den aur tumhen naye siray say uss aalam mein peda keren jiss say tum (bilkul) bey-khabar ho
Tumhen yaqeeni tor per pehli dafa ki pedaeesh maloom hi hai phir kiyon ibrat hasil nahi kertay?
Acha phir yeh bhi batlao kay tum jo kuch botay ho
Ussay tum hi ugatay ho ya hum uganay walay hain
Agar hum chahayen to ussay reza reza ker dalen aur tum heyrat kay sath baaten banatay hi reh jao
Kay hum per to tawaan hi parr gaya
Balkay)yeh hum bilkul mehroom hi reh gaye
Acha yeh batao kay jiss pani ko tum peetay ho
Ussay badlon say bhi tum hi utartay ho ya hum barsatay hain?
Agar humari mansha ho to hum ussay kerwa zehar ker den phir tum humari shukar-guzari kiyon nahi kertay?
Acha zara yeh bhi batao kay jo aag tum sulgatay ho
Uss kay darakht ko tum ney peda kiya hai ya hum uss kay peda kerney walay hain?
Hum ney ussay sabab naseehat aur musafiron kay faeeday ki cheez banaya hai
Pus apney boht baray rab kay naam ki tasbeeh kiya kero
Pus mein qasam khata hun sitaron kay girney ki
Aur tumhen ilm ho to yeh boht bari qasam hai
Kay be-shak yeh Quran boht bari izzat wala hai
Jo aik mehfooz kitab mein darj hai
Jissay sirf pak log hi chu saktay hain
Yeh rab aalameen ki taraf utra hua hai
Pus kiya tum aisi baat ko sirsari (aur mamooli) samajh rahey ho?
Aur apney hissay mein yehi letay ho kay jhutlatay phiro
Pus jabkay rooh narkharay tak phonch jaye
Aur tum uss waqt aankhon say dekhtay raho
Hum uss shakhs say ba nisbat tumharay boht ziyadah qareeb hotay hain lekin tum nahi dekh saktay
Pus agar tum kissi kay zair-e-farman nahi
Aur uss qol mein sachay ho to (zara) uss rooh ko to lotao
Pus jo koi baargaah elahi say qareeb kiya hua hoga
Ussay to rahat hai aur ghizayen hain aur aaram wali jannat hai
Aur jo shakhs dahanay (hath) walon mein say hai
To bhi salamti hai teray liye kay to dahanay walon mein say hai
Lekin agar koi jhutlanay walon gumrahon mein say hai
To kholtay huye garum pani ki mehmani hai
Aur dozakh mein jana hai
Yeh khabar sirasir haq aur qata’an yaqeeni hai
Pus apney azeem azeem-ul-shaan perwerdigar ki tasbeeh ker
